title: Supermarket freezers in European countries hit by apparent cyberattacks

blocks.text: STOCKHOLM — Supermarkets in Sweden, Belgium, Luxembourg, Ireland and Estonia were hit Monday by problems with freezers and fridges that apparently were caused by cyberattacks, forcing some to dispose of ruined food. The problems follow a case last month in which attackers remotely took control of refrigeration systems in hundreds of supermarkets and independent stores

why: doorway circuit open after repeated HTTP 403; direct circuit open after repeated HTTP 403
